fields.description: City Walk Crestlane brings apartments and duplex homes into an urban landscape of water features, gardens and shared recreation. The currently linked developer documents cover Crestlane 4 and 5. Their building-specific layouts and payment terms should be distinguished from the earlier Crestlane releases.

reviewCoverage.identity: Own dedicated developer page and project-named documents checked against protected identity; current release/tower scope retained.
reviewCoverage.location: Named community and Dubai setting verified by developer; no coordinates or drive-time guarantees invented.
reviewCoverage.residences: Named official apartment and special-residence types reviewed; explicit plan labels take precedence over incomplete headline ranges.
reviewCoverage.areas: Own plan packs extracted, then selected numbered tables visually inspected. Hidden or transposed PDF text was not treated as numeric evidence; printed area labels retained.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Own project-page and brochure facilities reviewed; shared/community facilities are not guaranteed private apartment inclusions.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Own dated developer release guides transcribed; no available allocation, valuation or live quotation claimed.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own dated schedule visually checked; eight stages total 100%. Past calendar dates retained as historical published instalments, not a fresh booking offer.
reviewCoverage.handover: Own payment document anticipated completion date visually checked; no contractual guarantee or actual completion inferred.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own official brochure, plan pack and dated payment sheet retrieved and inspected; source links retained for exact chosen-unit comparison.

overview: The published plans include compact one-bedroom homes, larger family apartments and ground-level duplexes. Crestlane 5’s four-bedroom Type C has a particularly large outdoor component: its advertised total includes balcony or terrace space, rather than representing enclosed rooms alone.
research.locationNote: City Walk, Dubai, as identified by Meraas. Confirm the selected building, entrance and unit outlook on its approved plan; surrounding facilities and travel conditions can change.
research.priceNote: The official guide starts at AED 2.70m for Crestlane 4 and AED 2.80m for Crestlane 5. The linked sheet also differentiates apartment and duplex prices. These are published release guides, not verified available-unit quotations; confirm the chosen building and remaining payment balance.
research.paymentNote: The linked developer document uses 20% booking, six construction instalments totalling 55% and 25% at anticipated handover. Some dates have already passed. This is the published release calendar, not confirmation that a new reservation receives those terms; obtain a dated unit offer and remaining-balance statement.
research.handoverNote: The currently linked payment sheets for both Crestlane 4 and 5 print estimated completion in April 2030. This date does not establish the programme of an earlier Crestlane release or override a selected buyer’s contract.
